description: This file defines the ModuleConfig class, which models configuration parameters for a system module, including fields like scheme, host, port, uri, environment, and additional configs.

classes.name: ModuleConfig
classes.description: A POJO class encapsulating system module configuration settings such as scheme, host, port, URI, environment, and additional configuration fields.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme (e.g., http or https) used in the module's URL.

methods.name: setScheme
methods.description: Sets the scheme (e.g., http or https) used in the module's URL.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host name for the module.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host name for the module.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the module.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port number for the module.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI path for the module.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI path for the module.
